title: dryopteris serrata
intro: Dryopteris serrata, commonly known as Tansan or Japanese shield fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris serrata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential benefits in treating conditions such as hypertension and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
